questions.question_text: One year Sami paid 18% of his earnings in tax. After paying tax he had $65 600. How much did Sami earn before paying tax?

Jennie’s investment gives 2.5% compound interest each year. After 5 years, how much more is the value of Sami’s investment than Jennie’s?
